research_question: What is the effectiveness of deep reinforcement learning and adaptive AI approaches for dynamic production planning and scheduling under disruptions?
population: Manufacturing production systems, including production lines, factories, and manufacturing plants.
intervention: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) and adaptive AI techniques applied to dynamic production planning and scheduling.
outcomes: Resilience to disruptions (e.g., downtime, supply chain interruptions)
context: Industrial manufacturing environments experiencing disruptions such as equipment failures, supply chain interruptions, or demand variability.
inclusion_criteria: Title and abstract mention deep reinforcement learning or adaptive AI applied to production planning or scheduling.
Population refers to manufacturing production systems or manufacturing plants.
Intervention explicitly involves DRL or adaptive AI techniques.
At least one of the specified outcomes is reported.
Study design is experimental, quasi‑experimental, observational, simulation, or benchmarking.
Paper is available in full text and includes quantitative or qualitative data.
exclusion_criteria: Editorials, opinion pieces, or commentaries without empirical data.
Studies that do not involve DRL or adaptive AI as the primary intervention.
Papers focusing solely on theoretical algorithm development without application to production planning/scheduling.
Studies that only report on static planning/scheduling without dynamic or disruption context.
Conference abstracts or posters without full manuscript.
